product_summary: Pellets Pharma Limited (Hyderabad, est. 2002, self-described 100% export-oriented) is a modified/sustained-release pellet and MUPS formulator. Real product lines from its own catalogue (pelletspharma.com/products): sustained-release pellets — diclofenac sodium 33%, diltiazem HCl 55%, indometacin 27.5%, ketoprofen 70%, propranolol HCl 47%, theophylline 60/75%, venlafaxine 30%, metoprolol succinate pellets 65% and MUPS 51.5%, tamsulosin HCl 0.12–0.267%, pseudoephedrine HCl 46.15/60%, pseudoephedrine sulphate 55%, memantine HCl 14/16%, methylphenidate HCl 11.18%, galantamine HBr 10.3%, cyclobenzaprine HCl 23%, fenofibrate SR 75%, mebeverine HCl 80%, levomilnacipran 20/40%, topiramate 40%, trimetazidine 53.33%, viloxazine HCl 41%, fluvoxamine maleate 60/62%; delayed-release — esomeprazole pellets/MUPS 7.5/15/22.5%, lansoprazole 8.5%, omeprazole 8.5%, dexlansoprazole 22.5%, duloxetine HCl 22.4%, dimethyl fumarate mini-tablets 50%, diroximel fumarate 55%, pancreatin DR 62.5%; immediate-release — aprepitant 40%, dabigatran etexilate mesylate 41%, dutasteride 0.333%, ebastine 10%, fenofibrate 66.3/66.7% and nano DC granules 22.6%, finasteride 5%, donepezil HCl 15%, orlistat 50%, linaclotide 0.09/0.26%; blended pellets — aspirin+dipyridamole, ebastine+pseudoephedrine, ferrous fumarate+folic acid, iron III polymaltose+zinc+B-complex+folic acid, memantine+donepezil, phentermine+topiramate, pseudoephedrine+loratadine, pseudoephedrine+fexofenadine, tamsulosin+dutasteride, tamsulosin+solifenacin; nutraceutical blends (carbonyl iron/ferrous sulphate + folic acid + B-complex + zinc, vitamin B12 SR, vitamin C+zinc); finished capsules in bulk packing (dimethyl fumarate DR 120/240 mg, esomeprazole DR 20/40 mg). Under development: mesalamine ER, methylphenidate ER for oral suspension, ramipril+amlodipine, rosuvastatin+choline fenofibrate, trospium+xanomeline.
comment: HS 300390 is the correct and dominant code: the company sells medicaments in bulk (pellets, MUPS, blended pellets, bulk capsules) — this matches the declared line and is corroborated by the product catalogue. HS 293590 is only partially plausible: the catalogue is a dosage-form/pellet portfolio, not a list of isolated heterocyclic APIs; no product page shows an isolated active substance for export, so 293590 is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (it would only apply to isolated actives such as aprepitant or dabigatran etexilate mesylate, which are listed as pellets, i.e. formulated). Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification — the company is a pharmaceutical formulator (pharma/chemical-pharma), not oil & gas. Trader signs: none — own R&D and manufacturing facility in Hyderabad, DMFs filed for many products, so manufacturer role. Product lines missing from the declaration: nutraceutical/food-supplement blends (iron + folic acid + B-complex + zinc, vitamin B12, vitamin C + zinc) which may fall under 210690 or 300450 depending on composition, and bulk finished capsules (300490). No customs line was available to me in this task, so all mapping is catalogue-based and marked as declared/not confirmed by shipment records. Per project rule 3, the partial HS match does not reject the company — code set is corrected/expanded to 300390 (+300490) as primary.
